note: Deletes the pre_delete signal receiver module and moves destination archiving into the facade's event stream delete path.
Adds a stage_register_writes helper in stage2 and replaces the duplicated put_stage2 loops in event_path, worker and seed_path with one call.
Renames the skill to a cross-platform stacktrace-symbolication name, generalizes SKILL.md wording, keeps the JS reference and script language-specific.
Adds dayjsNowInTimezone to lib/dayjs with tests and replaces the inline convert-format-reparse expression at the call site.
Adds _is_basic_list_request helper on CohortViewSet and uses it in both serializer context and queryset defer paths.
Removes run_source and signal_report_id from the task run extra_state; large commit also remodels signals/task relations.
Renames the Slack user resolver helpers in api.py to public names and updates all importers.
Extracts is_internal_request_inner taking token and headers, makes the public fn a wrapper, deletes the test copy; tests call the real inner fn.
Adds _run_detail module with shared RUN_DETAIL_COLUMNS and to_run_detail, used by workflow_run_list, pr_runs and workflow_run.
Makes Backpressure a generic PartitionHoldover<T>; SeedHoldover becomes a type alias and seeds.rs flattens take_held via drain_held.
Replaces EvaluationDisplay's inline result parsing with a shared normalizeEvaluationResultProperties helper in utils.ts.
Adds handleFlagApprovalRequired in updateFlagActiveInProject and uses it there and in featureFlagsLogic, removing the duplicated 409 handling.
inject_credentials now takes the InvocationContext and reads api_key, env_id and host from its config instead of get_token.
Single-flag delete guard now filters non-deleted experiments and checks exp.is_running instead of inline start/end date filters.
Removes the widget's own status derivation and uses a new Experiment.status_label model property shared with the serializer.
Renames normalizeConversation to normalizeMessages returning recognized/messages and updates call sites across the product.
Deletes the custom-agent repo_selection module and generalizes the shared select_repo prompt into select_repository_for_team for reuse.
Extracts _trim_trailing_settings and _prefix_cohort_hogql_params helpers and uses them in all three cohort SQL call sites.
Adds produce_membership helper that produces and books metrics, returning error count; all four sites use it and keep their own recovery.
Only switches CronExpressionParser.parseExpression to parse; cronstrue dependency is untouched.
